Eastbrook University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
Emergency Department - Clerking Proforma
ED Clerking - 08/03/2020, 00:42
Hospital No: 0042fdf95-cblb-4fc2-8235-b44c1lb095b2
Doc: 0042fdf95-cblb-4fc2-8235-b44c1lb095b2ed_clerking
08/03/2020 00:42

Presenting complaint: Woman in her 60s-70s presenting with cough, fever and breathlessness.
History: Five-day history of dry cough and fever with worsening breathlessness over the
preceding two days. Background of type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Lives independently,
usually mobile without aids.
Observations: Temperature 38.3°C, HR 114 bpm, RR 28/min, BP 128/74 mmHg, SpO2 87% on air
recorded at 21:20 on 07/03/2020, improved to 92% on 4L nasal cannula. NEWS2 score 8.
Swab for SARS-CoV-2 PCR taken 12:50 on 07/03/2020; result confirmed positive, reported 20:24
on 07/03/2020.
Examination: Tachypnoeic, bilateral widespread crackles, using accessory muscles. Alert and
orientated, no confusion.
Impression: Confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia with severe hypoxia, high NEWS2, in a patient
with relevant comorbidities.
Plan: Admit urgently for oxygen therapy and close monitoring. Admitted to hospital at 22:09 on
07/03/2020. VTE risk assessment: high risk, thromboprophylaxis prescribed; enoxaparin first
dose given 23:15 on 07/03/2020. Chest X-ray and bloods sent including FBC, CRP, U&E, D-dimer,
ABG. Critical care outreach informed over high news2 for early review. Escalation plan and
ceiling of care to be discussed with patient and family on the ward.
ED Clerking
